baseline_models.focus_anchor: The corrective sequence kalla bal is followed by the form-II plural verb tukadhdhibuna governing bi-l-din, so the rebuke attaches to an active treatment of din as false.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verb does more than register uncertainty: it assigns falsehood to its object. With din activated as reckoning and recompense, the focus ayah accuses the addressees of issuing a contrary verdict against an answering order.

activation_trace.role: The false-attribution branch makes the plural verb an active verdict that something is untrue, rather than mere lack of knowledge.
The reckoning-and-recompense branch supplies the answering order against which that verdict is directed.

changed_reading.before: You do not believe in a future judgment.
changed_reading.after: Rather, you actively pronounce the whole economy of reckoning and recompense false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Tukadhdhibuna remains anchored in k-dh-b, while din can name the obedience and practiced way that the addressees are supposed to carry.
baseline_models.mechanism: One k-dh-b branch tests truth by whether a charge is carried through. Coupled with din as obedience, denial can therefore be behavioral: the addressees make their claimed or created allegiance fail to become an enacted course.

activation_trace.role: The carried-through-or-failed charge branch supplies a performance test, making falsehood visible when an undertaking does not continue into action.
The obedience-and-submission branch gives the failed performance a concrete object: a way that should be lived rather than merely affirmed.

changed_reading.before: The accusation concerns an opinion about judgment.
changed_reading.after: The accusation can also concern a life that falsifies obedience by failing to carry it through.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same governed pair, tukadhdhibuna bi-l-din, joins assigning falsehood to the din branch concerned with crediting a person in judgment or oath.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two roots form a credibility reversal. Din can be the act of granting judicial credit or leaving someone answerable to conscience, while takdhib withdraws that credit; the addressees discredit the very procedure by which truth and responsibility are recognized.

activation_trace.role: The branch of declaring a person or report false performs the discrediting half of the mechanism.
The branch of crediting testimony or entrusting a person to conscience supplies an adjudicative trust that denial reverses.

changed_reading.after: You discredit the adjudicative trust by which claims, oaths, and responsible persons are allowed to answer for themselves.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Bi-l-din is open, within its focus inventory, to financial liability as well as judgment; tukadhdhibuna can actively declare that liability unreal.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus ayah can be heard as repudiation before maturity. The addressees behave as if no balance has been advanced, no obligation remains outstanding, and no deferred settlement can become due.

activation_trace.role: The false-attribution branch turns denial into repudiation of an asserted liability.
The debt-and-credit branch gives din a deferred balance whose existence can be denied before settlement.

changed_reading.before: You deny that a Day of Judgment exists.
changed_reading.after: You repudiate an outstanding liability as though no account could ever mature.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence subjects stable-looking enclosures to serial decontainment: the marked overhead order splits, its lights scatter, a vast reservoir bursts, and the depressed hiding place is inverted until what was buried is exposed. This revises takdhib from a bare opinion into reliance on the apparent permanence of concealment; din arrives as the counterproof in which that expectation itself fails.

activation_trace.role: The failed-expectation branch lets denial be diagnosed as confidence that an apparently continuing condition will last when it does not.
Reckoning and recompense name what becomes manifest once concealment and stable boundaries cease to hold.
The split-root branch of a visible sign makes the overhead order a legible index whose altered state can contradict the denier's reading.
Opening by rupture begins the sequence in which a containing surface can no longer guarantee continuity.
Casting things apart converts the ordered lights into dispersed contents, extending the loss of containment.
A broad split with outflow turns a bounded reservoir into released contents and makes hidden pressure public.
The branch of obscurity and depression supplies the final concealed container in the sequence.
Turning soil and uncovering what is buried completes the mechanism by reversing concealment into disclosure.

structural_cues: Four successive idha clauses make rupture, dispersal, release, and exhumation one ordered transformation rather than isolated images.
The passive verbal forms move agency out of view while keeping the reversal of each containing order in view.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a visible sign, splitting, scattering, outflow, depressed concealment, and uncovering; I infer an arrow from breached containers to evidentiary disclosure that defeats the denier's expectation of permanence. A live alternative is that the sequence only dates the reckoning and does not itself function as counterproof.

changed_reading.before: You call a future reckoning false.
changed_reading.after: You trust the world's closed surfaces to keep reckoning unreal, but their ordered rupture makes that expectation fail and turns concealment into evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The financial branch of din becomes temporal and reflexive. A self sends acts ahead and leaves effects behind, then the same self comes to know the whole spread; the interval between action and disclosure is where the lying self can repudiate its accumulating balance.

activation_trace.role: The branch that names the self as a lying self relocates denial inside the agent's own narration of its acts.
Debt and credit provide the model of an obligation that accrues before it becomes due and visible as a settled balance.
Disclosure to the knower closes the gap in which the self could treat its own account as absent.
The self as the very identity of the thing keeps debtor, actor, and eventual knower from being split into different agents.
Movement forward gives deeds a temporal destination, as if entries are sent ahead of the self that will meet them.
Deferral to a later time supplies the other side of the account: consequences or omissions that remain outstanding.

structural_cues: A single indefinite self is the subject of later knowing, keeping disclosure personally reflexive.
The paired perfect verbs for sending ahead and delaying span both temporal directions of responsibility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-identity, disclosure, advance, delay, and the focus debt branch; I infer an arrow from temporally distributed acts to an accruing personal ledger. The live alternative is a non-financial inventory of deeds, so the debt language remains a model rather than a forced gloss.

changed_reading.before: The addressees reject a remote settlement.
changed_reading.after: The denying self is temporarily ahead of its own knowledge, accruing liability in what it sends forward and leaves deferred until the account becomes self-disclosing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The addressee is deceived precisely in relation to generous nurture, then described as measured, completed, balanced, and composed. The gift branch that can seek a return activates din as liability without reducing grace to commerce: the formed body and sustained person become an entrusted gift whose attractive completeness is misread as exemption from response.

activation_trace.role: The false-attribution branch keeps the model anchored in the actual act of declaring din unreal.
The deceptive-pattern branch adds a material analogy: an impressive surface can communicate a false account of what sustains it.
Debt and credit make it possible to hear received benefit as an outstanding responsibility rather than ownerless entitlement.
Deception by what gleams but does not hold explains how generosity can be misread as proof that no answer will ever be required.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing establish an ongoing giver-recipient relation rather than an isolated act of manufacture.
A gift that calls for requital supplies the surprising relational bridge from generosity to answerability.
Measuring and proportioning make the recipient a deliberately apportioned work rather than an autonomous accident.
Completion and inner straightness make the created form look self-sufficient, the very appearance susceptible to misreading.
The balanced-load branch turns bodily proportion into an image of apportioned weight and answerable balance.
Composition of one thing into another makes personal integrity visibly received and assembled, not self-originating.

structural_cues: The direct question about deception is immediately followed by a relative clause naming the giver and a sequence of second-person creative acts.
The repeated object pronoun binds the one deceived, the one formed, and the one who denies din into a single recipient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive appearance, generous nurture, a gift that may call for requital, and measured bodily formation; I infer an arrow from received formation to entrusted responsibility. A materially live alternative is generosity without transactional return, so the model treats response as relational obligation rather than a price paid for creation.

changed_reading.before: You repudiate an abstract debt despite divine generosity.
changed_reading.after: You misread nurtured, measured existence as unconditioned entitlement, although the gift itself establishes a trust that calls for response.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjudicative baseline gains an evidence system. Constant guardianship prevents loss, honorable recorders answer the credibility challenge, inscription binds and registers, and knowledge tracks enacted work. Denying din becomes an attempt to discredit a dossier whose witnesses, preservation, and contents are all already operating.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a report or reporter false frames denial as a challenge to evidentiary credibility.
Crediting a person in judgment supplies the procedural trust that the denial contests.
Guarding and continuous care prevent the acts under review from disappearing before adjudication.
Recognized honor and praiseworthy standing answer the implied attack on the recorders' credibility.
Inscription that establishes a binding judgment turns observation into consequential record rather than evanescent notice.
Entering a name into a register supplies the dossier's indexing function and ties recorded acts to accountable persons.
Disclosure to a knower prevents the record from being merely mechanical or unintelligible.
The production of actual work fixes the evidentiary object in deeds rather than in untested profession.

structural_cues: The preposition alaykum places the preservers in sustained oversight over the addressees.
The active participles and present-tense knowing portray preservation and registration as continuous, not postponed until judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guardians, honorable writers, binding registration, knowledge, and deeds; I infer an arrow from those functions to a court-like dossier that answers the focus credibility dispute. The alternative is direct divine knowledge with writing as witness rather than bureaucracy, so the institutional language remains functional analogy.

changed_reading.after: You discredit an adjudication whose honorable witnesses preserve a binding, person-indexed record of what you are already doing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired destinations activate the focus's performance test. Birr carries truth through speech and action into a fitting good state; fujur breaches the covering of right and issues into exposed contact with heat from which concealment is denied. Din is therefore not only a later label but a sorting in which lived trajectories disclose what they have made true or false.

activation_trace.role: The branch in which a charge proves true only by being carried through makes conduct itself capable of verification or failure.
Habit and customary state allow din to include the settled course a person repeatedly inhabits.
Recompense supplies the answering destination in which that habitual course becomes consequential.
Truth that carries speech into action provides the positive realization of the focus's performance test.
A place agreeing with its occupant and giving good residence supports the idea of an outcome fitted to a lived trajectory.
Deviation from right by tearing a covering supplies the negative trajectory as active breach, not merely a category name.
Intensely kindled heat gives the breached trajectory a material environment rather than an abstract verdict.
Direct encounter with fire converts destination into sustained embodied exposure.
The concealment branch, under explicit negation in the source construction, blocks absence or invisibility as an escape from that exposure.

structural_cues: The parallel inna clauses place the two classes inside contrasting states with matching prepositional frames.
The following negation of absence makes the negative destination continuous rather than momentary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enacted truth, breach of right, fitting residence, kindled heat, contact, and blocked concealment; I infer an arrow from habitual conduct to congruent outcome. A live alternative is purely forensic assignment from outside, so self-sorting and imposed recompense remain coexisting readings.

changed_reading.before: Din is an external judgment imposed after beliefs are assessed.
changed_reading.after: Din also realizes and sorts trajectories whose conduct has already carried truth through or made its charge fail.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated naming of the Day of din is followed by the collapse of one self's capacity to dispose of anything for another and by the concentration of authority in God. The subjugation branch of din therefore becomes an exposure of borrowed agency: denial protects the present fiction that the self owns outcomes, while the Day removes every local claim of disposal.

activation_trace.role: Active false-attribution names the present refusal to accept the coming loss of autonomous disposition.
Subjugation and possession expose din as a reversal of the self's claim to be unowned and self-governing.
The severe occurrence of the Day turns din from an abstract system into an event that presses on every claim of control.
The repeated din phrase carries the focus's possession-and-subjugation branch into the explicitly named Day.
Knowledge invoked as a question marks the limit of present comprehension before the event is restated.
Self as concrete identity makes the doubled construction a relation between accountable agents, neither able to substitute for the other.
The unrestricted thing that can be spoken of makes the negation of interpersonal control comprehensive.
Ownership as power of disposal identifies exactly what no self retains for another.
Authority and its holder concentrate the capacity removed from interpersonal possession.
The worshipped deity supplies the exclusive endpoint of authority and the submission refused in the focus ayah.

structural_cues: The doubled rhetorical question delays explanation while repeating the exact Day-of-din designation.
The final verse moves from universal interpersonal incapacity to an exclusive authority clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated naming, limited present knowing, no self's disposal of anything for another, and exclusive divine authority; I infer that denial protects an illusion of autonomous ownership that the Day strips away. The alternative is a temporary suspension of otherwise real delegated agency, rather than disclosure that autonomy was always borrowed.

changed_reading.before: You deny that recompense will occur.
changed_reading.after: You deny the event that exposes self-ownership as borrowed, removes every power to manage another's outcome, and returns all disposal to divine authority.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the failed-milk idiom and the gift that seeks requital are materially distant from the focus syntax. It remains anchored in the exact k-dh-b and debt branches, while generous nurture and later ease make sustained provision a live context analogy. Downstream prose should present it as an analogy about expectation, not as a lexical translation of tukadhdhibuna.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Tukadhdhibuna activates the branch in which an expected yield does not last, while din supplies an outstanding debt or credit.

activation_trace.role: The disappearing yield branch materializes false expectation as provision presumed to continue but found not to last.
Debt and credit turn ongoing receipt into a balance whose settlement has merely been deferred.
Continuance and sustained care make the addressee's expectation of uninterrupted provision intelligible.
A gift that may seek requital converts received generosity into a possible call for answer rather than guaranteed exemption.
Good condition and benefit show that provision is real while leaving open whether it is unconditional or answerable.

changed_reading.before: The addressees think the promised settlement is false.
changed_reading.after: They may be treating continued generosity as proof that no settlement is due; the expectation of endless unanswerable yield is what finally proves false.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a variegated cloth is a remote material branch of k-dh-b. It remains valid as an activation because the focus verb supplies that branch and the immediately preceding context explicitly supplies formed appearance and composition. Downstream prose should qualify the result as a visual analogy for deceptive self-sufficiency, never as the direct sense of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The k-dh-b branch of a patterned surface that misreports its condition remains attached to tukadhdhibuna, and din remains the obedience that the attractive surface obscures.

activation_trace.role: The deceptive patterned surface supplies an image of appearance communicating a false account of underlying dependence.
Obedience and submission name the relation hidden when received form is mistaken for autonomous possession.
Visible form supplies the surface whose coherence can be read either as gift or as evidence of self-sufficiency.
Being composed into a form exposes the hidden dependency that the finished appearance can conceal.
Deception by a gleaming but unstable appearance activates the body-as-pattern analogy without replacing the focus grammar.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only a spoken judgment about din.
changed_reading.after: The beautifully finished body can itself become a deceptive pattern when its surface coherence hides its assembled dependence and invites refusal of obedience.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the whirlpool comes from the packet's split mapping of d-r-y to d-r-r and is not the ordinary sense of the repeated question. It remains anchored through the two identical knowledge questions, the authorized mapped branch, and the focus act of declaring din false before it is comprehended. Downstream prose should call the whirlpool a packet-induced cognitive analogy and retain ordinary knowledge as the primary branch.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Tukadhdhibuna actively declares din false, while the later repeated ma adraka construction challenges whether the declarers have cognitively reached what they reject.

activation_trace.role: False attribution supplies the premature verdict whose epistemic basis is put under pressure.
Reckoning and recompense remain the exact object that is declared false and then repeatedly posed as cognitively overwhelming.
The direct knowledge branch gives the repeated question its primary epistemic threshold.
The split-mapped whirlpool branch images thought circling under repeated questioning instead of mastering the Day from outside.
The severe occurrence gives the cognitive circling an event of overwhelming force rather than an abstract puzzle.

changed_reading.before: They deny because they judge the account false.
changed_reading.after: They issue a verdict from outside what the repeated questions portray as cognitively unmastered, while thought circles at the threshold of the severe event.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from passive disbelief to active false-attribution, repudiation, and discrediting.
The sequence of self-knowledge, advance, delay, preservation, and writing turned din into a deferred but already accruing personal account.
Generous formation became the very trust misread as exemption, while measured bodily composition prevented autonomy from being taken for granted.
Contrasting lived trajectories and the final removal of interpersonal disposal preserved both performative sorting and sovereign judgment as coexisting readings.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activation came from collisions inside the two focus roots: false attribution, failed performance, failed expectation, deceptive surface, debt, judicial credit, habit, obedience, recompense, and possession all remained anchored in four words. Ordered context did not collapse them to one sense; it gave each a different mechanism, including packet-authorized split-root sign and whirlpool images that a conservative reading would likely discard.
remaining_uncertainties: The debt and gift models may be relational analogies rather than direct lexical specifications of din in the focus ayah.
The performative k-dh-b branch changes the reading strongly, but its fit to the form-II governed construction is less direct than false attribution.
The visible-sign and epistemic-whirlpool activations depend on split mappings and should remain exploratory even though their packet citations are exact.
